The '''Cessna 172 Skyhawk''' is an American four-seat, single-engine, [[Monoplane#High|high wing]],
[[fixed-wing aircraft]] made by the [[Cessna Aircraft Company]]. It was developed from the
[[Cessna 170]], but with [[tricycle landing gear]] rather than [[conventional landing gear]].
